model.name: dimerized Heisenberg, delta = 1//4, two-spin cells, rotated frame

claim: every even ring length L >= n0 has a unique ground state and spectral gap > gap_lower_bound

reflection_positivity.identity: -h = sum_a weight_a * kron(C_a, R * conj(C_a) * R)

coupled_seed.method: coupling identity: complete verified spectrum of the ring of n0 cells, Rayleigh-Ritz lower bounds on Z of the ring of 2n0 cells
coupled_seed.padding: defects raised by 1e-9 and rounded up to the grid 1e-9
